name: phone_scan
goal: Phone scanner in the left hand (from Ayush's demo): left claw opens, the phone is put in, gentle grip; left arm holds the phone over the parcel until it scans the label; the harness routes the code (zone); left arm back; right arm picks the parcel and lifts it; WALLX carries it into the scanned zone; release; phone handed back.
setup: Parcel label-up where the demo picked it (right of centre, in front of zone 2's front-left corner); phone scanner page open (3x); arms at rest. Stand by to put the phone in and take it out.
